translations.web: Let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.
translations.bsb: Additionally, they must first be tested. Then, if they are above reproach, let them serve as deacons.
translations.kjv: And let ➔ these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.
